required_headers.name: Content-Security-Policy
required_headers.impact: Mitigates Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) and data injection attacks.
required_headers.recommendation: Define a strict CSP header restricting script-src and object-src.

required_headers.name: Strict-Transport-Security
required_headers.impact: Protects against SSL-stripping and man-in-the-middle (MitM) attacks.

required_headers.name: X-Frame-Options
required_headers.impact: Prevents Clickjacking by restricting framing permissions.

required_headers.name: Referrer-Policy
required_headers.impact: Controls how much referrer information is included with requests.
